open_points.subject: Installation.service_instances cardinality
open_points.text: State 0 K-16: "An installation selects one manifest instance per service"; State 1 M28: "service_instances: at most one selected instance per service ... a service with none selected is not invocable"
open_points.question: Must an installation select exactly one instance for every service, or may some services have no selected instance?
options: Exactly one selected instance per service (configuration without one is invalid)
Zero-or-one selected instance per service (unselected services are allowed but cannot be invoked)
open_points.default_guess: Zero-or-one selected instance per service, because M28 defines behavior for none-selected services.

open_points.subject: FlowActivation behavior when activating an already active flow version
open_points.text: M18: "A flow's active version is the one recorded last ... a new activation replaces the previous one at once"; State 0 action "activate a flow" does not state what happens if the requested version is already active.
open_points.question: If the owner/agent asks to activate the same flow version that is already active, does the kernel create a new FlowActivation record or return the existing active state unchanged?
options: Create a new FlowActivation record (idempotent in effect, not in history)
Return existing active state with no new record
open_points.default_guess: Return existing active state with no new record.

open_points.subject: Run.status at creation when run immediately waits
open_points.text: M19 lists status values and lifecycle "`running` ↔ `awaiting_approval` | `pending`" but does not state the initial status rule at run start.
open_points.question: When a run starts and its first executable node(s) immediately require owner approval or hit unreachable service, is the initial persisted status `running` first, or directly `awaiting_approval`/`pending`?
options: Always create as `running`, then transition if/when waiting is detected
Create directly in `awaiting_approval` or `pending` when that is already true at start
open_points.default_guess: Create directly in `awaiting_approval`/`pending` if already waiting at start; otherwise `running`.
